claims.claim: Water has historically been treated in nutrition mainly as solvent/volume/cleaner/thermoregulator rather than as an energy source.
Melanin has an intrinsic property to split and re-form the water molecule.
Human cells use water as a source of electrons in a plant-like manner.
Water is the primary energy source, and meals are merely the source of biomass.
Glucose is a universal building block from which the organism can synthesize even nucleic acids.
Energy for cellular change is obtained from dissociation and re-formation of water.
Melanin is the equivalent of human chlorophyll.
Both melanin and chlorophyll can transform photonic energy into free chemical energy usable by eukaryotic cells.
Most metabolic pathways explaining glucose as the premier energy source are controversial in 95%.
The beginning of life likely required conversion of light to chemical energy via water dissociation.
Energy from melanin is transported by molecular hydrogen (H2) and high-energy electrons.
Organic molecules within melanin-derived growing spheres change chemical behavior in a highly ordered way.
Melanin water dissociation/reformation alternates liquid/gas states and can be represented as a 0/1 binary code.
Every molecule involved in life processes must be continuously immersed in melanin energy spheres night and day.
Food’s main aim is replenishment of biomass; the energy content of meals is very low.
The body can store carbon chains but cannot store energy.
Oxygen’s role over nutrient molecules is merely for biomass production/replenishment, not energy production.
The chemo-osmotic theory is only a theory and does not explain ATP energy storage/release.
Yeast growth without oxygen is energetically nonsensical because 2 ATP vs 30–36 ATP has no sense.
ATP and mitochondria are more oriented to phosphate-group regulation than energy production.
ATP hydrolysis absorbs more energy than it releases.
In healthy people all copies of mitochondrial DNA are identical.
Red blood cells and eye lens have no mitochondria and therefore cannot respire aerobically.
Heme and chlorophyll can both split water irreversibly.
The dissociation of water is the real source of energy of erythrocytes.
The iris has about 40% more melanin than skin.
Cancer cells and embryonic tissues producing lactate in oxygen is difficult to reconcile with glucose-as-energy.
Warburg-like metabolism reflects prioritization of biomass carbon incorporation and phosphate handling rather than ATP production.
Enzyme activity loss in cancer is due to low chemical energy from water dissociation rather than glucose.
Utero-placental tissue consumes more O2 per kg than fetus; fetal O2 uptake is about 45% of total in cited measurements.
Low fetal pO2 and lower fetal O2 consumption are paradoxical if glucose oxidation is the energy source.
Adult energy comes from ingested water and fetal energy comes mainly from amniotic fluid.
Intracellular oxygen comes mainly from in situ water dissociation/reformation.
The fundamental reaction 2H2O ↔ 2H2 + O2 + 4e− occurs in perinuclear space.
Melanosomes are mainly perinuclear and form a wrapper around the nucleus.
ATP cannot reach the nucleus interior; therefore melanin supplies nuclear energy.
Oxygen is toxic at any level.
Melanin content is inversely related to mitochondrial number up to 83%.
Cold acclimation increases mitochondrial density and mitochondrial volume fraction in fish muscle as reported.
Cold reduces water-dissociation turnover; mitochondria increase mainly for thermogenesis/signaling/phosphate-calcium regulation rather than energy.
Melanin absorbs the entire electromagnetic spectrum from radio waves to gamma rays.
Melanin uniquely dissipates absorbed energy by dissociating water; laboratory water dissociation requires about 2000 °C.
Molecular hydrogen is the best antioxidant and melanin produces it.
Heavy metals poison melanin, impairing the reaction and causing free radical production (monoatomic H/O and hydroxyl species).
Melanin is the missing link in the origin of life sequence.
Melanin’s light-to-chemical-energy ability declines starting at age 26 by about 10% per decade and drops sharply after the 50s.
Age-related loss of bone/muscle/skin mass follows from declining melanin energy production because loss of energy causes loss of mass.
Seasonal depression is proof that affective problems relate to altered energy generation/distribution.
Every cell/tissue requires light; lower skin melanin in cold countries allows light penetration to meet energy needs even for bone.

concepts.definition: Proposed melanin-mediated photochemical conversion of light energy into chemical energy via water dissociation/reformation in human cells.
Proposed reversible reaction 2H2O ↔ 2H2 + O2 + 4e− occurring in perinuclear space around melanosomes.
Proposed diffusion-like radial propagation of alternating dissociated/re-formed water states carrying H2 and electrons outward from melanin.
Aerobic glycolysis in many cancers (lactate production despite oxygen availability).
ATP synthesis driven by proton motive force across inner mitochondrial membrane via ATP synthase.
Mitochondrial permeability transition pore phenomenon; transient openings can occur under some conditions.
Mitochondrial membrane potential (matrix negative) contributing to proton motive force.
Membrane-bound organelle containing melanin pigment, produced by melanocytes and transferred to other cells.
Pigment accumulating in certain catecholaminergic neurons such as substantia nigra.
Histochemical silver reduction method used to visualize melanin/argentaffin substances.

concepts.term: Henry’s law (temperature dependence of gas solubility)
concepts.definition: Gas solubility in liquids depends on partial pressure and temperature; oxygen solubility decreases with increasing temperature.

logical_flow: Observation -> Water is abundant in the body and historically treated as a passive medium in nutrition.
Hypothesis -> Melanin can dissociate and re-form water using light, generating usable chemical energy.
Mechanism -> Photonic energy drives 2H2O ↔ 2H2 + O2 + 4e−; energy is carried by H2/e− and spreads as diffusion-like spheres.
Implication -> Food supplies biomass precursors; energy is supplied primarily by melanin-water cycling rather than glucose oxidation.
Reinterpretation -> Oxygen is not primarily for energy extraction; ATP/mitochondria primarily regulate phosphate (and calcium) rather than produce energy.
Extension -> Cancer metabolism, fetal oxygen patterns, oxygen toxicity, and aging are reframed as consequences of altered melanin-driven energy generation/distribution.
Clinical implication -> Age-related diseases and mood disorders become targets via restoring mass–energy balance through melanin-centered mechanisms.
